Ciclosporin has occasionally been associated with myopathy.1-6 The manufacturer noted that 29 cases had been reported by December 1990, which appeared to be divided into cases of toxic or non-specific myopathy or mild sensory motor neuropathy, which were generally dose- related; and rhabdomyolysis, often, but not always, when used with lovastatin or colchicine.7 Rhabdomyolysis has also been re- ported when other statins were used with ciclosporin, see Lipid Regulating Drugs, under Interaction
